Certainly! Here are two hints for the given step:

**Hint 1:** Consider the properties of mean-centering. When you mean-center a dataset, you adjust the data so that the mean of each feature (except the intercept) is zero. How does this affect the intercept term in a linear regression model?

**Hint 2:** Think about the role of the intercept in a linear regression model. When the data is mean-centered, the intercept term often represents the mean of the response variable. What happens to this term when the response variable is also mean-centered?
